    transitions = case['transitions']

        raise ValueError(f"Initial state '{initial}' not found in transitions")
    
    # Validate each transition

        kind = state_data.get('kind')
        if kind not in ('action', 'final'):
            raise ValueError(f"State '{state_name}' has invalid kind '{kind}'")
        if kind == 'action':
            action = state_data.get('action')
            if not isinstance(action, str):
                raise ValueError(f"State '{state_name}' action missing or invalid")

                raise ValueError(f"State '{state_name}' action '{action}' not in tool_observations")

            default_next = state_data.get('default_next')

        elif kind == 'final':
            value = state_data.get('value')
            if not isinstance(value, str):
                raise ValueError(f"Final state '{state_name}' missing or invalid value")

    steps = 0
